methodologicalNotes: Dual-stemmer cross-check (CAMeL Tools + Wensinck) over Quranic corpus. Agreement rate: 53.14%. Delta (disagreement rate): 42-50%. The 131-entry alias map from Itqan closes the gap to achieve 96.3% coverage in their production system. Our simulated stemmers show 46.86% disagreement, which falls in the 42-50% range and is too high for production use. This artefact documents the measurement only; no index is shipped. Limitations: stemmers are rule-based approximations (SIMULATED), not production morphological analyzers; no validation against gold-standard root dictionary; does not handle Quranic orthography variants (hamza forms, alif maqsura, etc.).
